title: Easiness over characteristic zero fields
description:
Preprint (24 pages, PDF and LaTeX source), together with the code used for its computations.

The easy quantum groups have intertwiners T_π, depending on set-theoretic partitions π, with integer entries, and so are defined over Q. We study them over an arbitrary field F of characteristic 0. Easiness itself does not depend on F, the Haar functional being given by the Weingarten formula, and the field comes into play via the F-forms: those of O_N^+, coming from the central simple algebras with orthogonal involution and from the quadratic forms up to similarity, and a family of F-forms of S_N^+, coming from the finite étale algebras. Over Q, the free bistochastic group B_N^+ is isomorphic to O_{N-1}^+ precisely when N is an odd square, a multiple of 4, or 2 modulo 4 and a sum of 2 squares. We also discuss the quantum symmetries of the free quadrics, described by bilinear forms, and a rational form of the quantum group G_3 coming from the color sector of the Standard Model. Finally, we discuss free probability over F, and the p-adic case, where the Poisson laws are bounded measures on Z_p only for small parameters, while the Gaussian laws and the laws of the main characters of O_N^+ and S_N^+ never are.
